`requirements.md` has been written to `.sdlc/runs/20261106-152445-feature-new-pages/requirements.md`.

### Summary of Contents
- **In scope (1–11):** Testable scope covering ordered named pages, tab bar UI & actions, per-page scene isolation, per-page viewports, page-scoped undo/redo, active-page visual export vs. full-drawing JSON serialization, legacy file restore onto the deterministic default page, cross-page search, live collaboration sync, local storage persistence, and English locale + docs updates.
- **Out of scope (1–7):** Carries all Gate 0 non-goals (cross-page bindings/groups/frames, move-to-page command, page thumbnails/per-page background/grid, multi-page PDF/ZIP export, per-page libraries/permissions, non-`en.json` locales, and off-limits files).
- **Functional requirements per module (`FR-1` to `FR-19`):** Grouped by `packages/element`, `packages/excalidraw`, `packages/common`, `excalidraw-app` (collaboration and local storage), and `dev-docs/docs/`.
- **Non-functional requirements (`NFR-1` to `NFR-5`):** Encodes the exact Gate 0 test command (`yarn test:typecheck && yarn test:code && yarn test:app --watch=false`), the snapshot preservation and deterministic default-page ID rules, `.gitignore` and restricted file/folder naming rules, codebase conventions, and backward compatibility.
- **PII inventory & Role matrix:** Documents user-authored `page.name` encryption in collaboration and behaviors across Local Editor (edit and view modes), Collaborator, and Older Peer without pages.
- **Acceptance criteria (`AC-1` to `AC-11`):** Carries all nine criteria from the approved brief plus executable criteria for the Gate 0 snapshot and repository hygiene rules.
- **Open questions for HITL (`OQ-1`, `OQ-2`):** Documents the architectural trade-off between `pageId` on elements vs. separate element arrays per page, and defines what an older peer without page support sees in collaboration and shared files.
